install.description: apt-get update, then installs the missing packages from the list. No-op when all are installed.
install.title: Install packages

uninstall.description: Purges the packages in the list and autoremoves what is left unused. No-op when none are installed.
uninstall.title: Uninstall packages

update.description: apt-get update, then upgrades only the packages in the list. No-op when all are current.
update.title: Update packages

verify.description: Read-only check that every package in the list is installed. Exits non-zero when one is missing.
verify.title: Verify packages

description: Installs, verifies, updates and removes a fixed set of Debian packages from the distribution archives. The package list is a parameter, not a free-form command. Targets Debian 12/13 and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04.
name: packages
title: Packages
